answer: A newcomer joins only when three harbors from three different canyons lock n×base ember behind it, n counting the identities its paying origin has already admitted — transfers trace to origin, so side wallets share one count. Ember is minted solely by an identity's own verified work and never moves, so clones cannot stake for clones. A canyon that proves one lineage member fake burns every ember its harbors locked and keeps it. Its k clones thus cost base×k(k+1)/2 of bought harbor stakes, all burnable at one verdict, while a fresh origin's newcomer locks base.
